claim: Implementation and source investigation only; not owner acceptance or qualified issuer execution.

domains.purchasedElectricityMWh: Finite nonnegative site purchased electricity, explicitly sourced or explicitly conditional; never inferred from Scope2 tonnes or manufacturing GW.
domains.prices: Finite nonnegative nominal major currency/MWh, same currency and delivery period. A contextual regional average is not an issuer tariff.
domains.customerRecoveryFraction: [0,1], source contract or declared conditional assumption; no default and no empirical coefficient invented.
domains.supplierPaymentFraction: [0,1], incremental expense settled in this period; explicit assumption or source.
domains.customerCollectionFraction: [0,1], incremental recovery collected in this period; explicit assumption or source.
domains.period: Single annual delivery period with explicit year; no forward filling of expired prices.
domains.scope: Purchased electricity price channel only. Direct Scope2 carbon liability is prohibited.
domains.cashBridge: Replace neither baseline electricity expense nor an already included working-capital change. Explicit incremental-above-baseline / excluded-from-baseline sentinels required.
domains.executionAdmission: All applicable source records observed by cutoff, source-matched site/supplier/tariff, same annual period/currency; conditional inputs remain visibly conditional.

notSolvedOrAssumed: Issuer supply voltage, load profile, retailer or tariff eligibility
Customer cost recovery entitlement or cash settlement fractions
Source-qualified issuer cash impact without complete admissible inputs
preservation: No edits to 14 FaIR pins, archives, frozen negatives, ledgers, auth, billing or database schema.
